how: An 85 means Strong: a near perfect match on paper, plus someone inside who has seen Alex's work and will refer. Alex cannot get there on requirements alone, because years in the role cannot be added this year. The road runs through a warm path into Initech Robotics, verified proof of the scheduling rollout, and a tailored application for each best-fit role.
